node.title: XR six-face Plucker syzygies remove three rank-two profiles
node.statement: On a six-set X, t selected five-faces with distinct split-pencil colors obey one fractional-linear color law. Their canonical dual-cubic face words mu_i have an exact left-syzygy space ker(1;x_i;gamma_i;x_i gamma_i) of dimension t-3, because that matrix has rank three. Conversely every R=6 rank-two trade from the support atlas is one of these forced local Plucker syzygies. After quotienting their span from the parity stack's left kernel, only the two nonlocal rank-two profiles (t,R;z)=(4,7;1,2,2,2) and (4,8;2,2,2,2) remain. This is an exact known-syzygy quotient, not a payment of the two residual profiles.
